Name: PokeMania - Old Version
Author: TheKrominator
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HddtBOT.png[/img]

[size=3]Stardew Valley has become home to a large surplus of Pokemon! Every day, you can come face to face with the creatures and items of the Pokemon world. 
Find them all!
There are over 50 different Pokemon wandering this peaceful valley. 
The influence of Pokemon can be felt all over the farm: from cooking recipes to furniture. Even the fruits growing on the trees are the favorite berries of so many Pokemon.
[/size][size=3]
A few hints:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Remember that Mr Mime holds a secret. [/size]
[*][size=3]Pancham secretly loves maple syrup.[/size]
[*][size=3]Growlithe or Luxio can be your pets.[/size]
[*][size=3]Keep an eye out for some imports from Alola.[/size]
[*][size=3]Special appearance by Jynx![/size]
[/list][size=3]
Now SMAPI-Friendly! No Content Manager required

Future Plans :
- Evolve Pokemon
- Castforms change based on weather

[/size]Many Sprites were sampled from [url=https://www.spriters-resource.com/ds_dsi/pokemonmysterydungeonexplorersoftimedarkness/]here[/url]﻿
Or I made them myself!
